variant.name: preserved_absorption
variant.description: plant_trip also switches in a collector reactor b = Q0/z0^2 (absorbs Q0 at z0)

scenario.name: light_load
scenario.description: light load (every PQ load at 60 % of the stock P and Q), RES = 50 % of the scaled load, all synchronous units online with one common dispatch factor and a must-run minimum, stock voltage set points, taps within +/-10 %
scenario.res_share_reason: capped by must-run: 1440 MW committed minimum vs 858 MW required at the requested share 0.50 (scaled load 1640 MW - RES 820 MW + losses 38 MW); 4 of 4 units on the governor-minimum basis

dispatch.units_unit_note: all *_pu fields of 'units' are converted to MW (system base 100 MVA)
dispatch.rule_text: one common factor k for every synchronous unit (PV and slack): P_i = max(k P_i,stock, must-run_i); must-run_i = max(20 % of capability_i, governor VMIN_i), capped at the stock output; capability = min(PV.pmax if < 99 pu, MVA rating if >= stock output); units with stock output <= 0 unchanged; k solved so that the slack produces exactly its own share (loss-corrected on the final power flow); voltage set points unchanged, all units online

placement.rule: candidates: in-service buses with Vn >= 200 kV, no static or synchronous generator, in the slack's island, short-circuit ratio S_sc/P_max >= 3 (S_sc: reactance network, machines through x''d; P_max = largest block). Strong set S: S_sc >= median over candidates. Hubs: strongest bus of S, then farthest-point (max-min effective reactance) sampling within S. Members: clusters take turns adding the nearest unassigned bus to their hub, first from S then from all candidates, skipping buses within 0.005 pu effective reactance of a placed plant (one plant per substation). Ties by bus order.

generator_trip_rule: largest in-service synchronous machines by MVA rating (ties: |P|, idx) not linked to the slack; trip sets u=0 on the machine and every linked exciter/governor/PSS
load_disconnection_rule: largest |q0| in-service PQ loads (n_blocks/2), signed; q<0 loads flagged

redispatch.pairing_rule: down units in exporting, up units in importing (pseudo-)areas, ranked by P; a pair is used only if the down unit stays above max(must-run, governor VMIN) and the up unit below min(governor VMAX, capability) after the 20 % exchange
